claims.evidence: Retrieved NHS text lists pounding heart, fast breathing, shaking, wobbly legs; dizziness, sweating, breathlessness and dread not seen
claims.newSentence: A panic attack causes physical symptoms such as a pounding heart, fast breathing and shaking, and many people fear the next attack.

claims.evidence: 5 to 20 minutes supported (some up to an hour); 'fighting it makes it worse' not stated in any retrieved text
claims.newSentence: The NHS says a panic attack usually lasts between 5 and 20 minutes, although some last longer.

claims.newSentence: Cognitive behavioural therapy is offered for repeated panic attacks, and in England people can refer themselves to an NHS talking therapies service.

notes: Search summaries were thin on nhs.uk page text; many symptom and self-help details probably appear on the live NHS pages but were not stated in retrieved text, so they were reworded to what was seen. 'Fighting it makes it worse' (c02, c13) was explicitly not found. The 111 option 2 source is a trust page, so the author should confirm on nhs.uk before publishing. c04/c26/c27 are signposting written in second person; acceptable as emergency wording but could be rephrased to third person. Wording NHS avoids: 'fighting' a panic attack.
